name: Tiago Cruz + Trocado
description: Experience one of Porto's most iconic clubs in the heart of the Galerias district, with a Saturday night lineup promising great vibes and danceable beats.
longDescription:
On Saturday, July 11, 2026, Plano B hosts a nightlife event featuring Tiago Cruz and Trocado. This evening brings together two names in the local music scene for a night of DJ sets. Tiago Cruz is known for his selections that span various electronic genres, while Trocado contributes to the sonic landscape with his own distinct style. The event is part of Plano B's regular programming, offering a platform for both established and emerging artists.

Attendees can expect an evening of music designed for dancing within Plano B's multi-room setting. The venue, located in the Galerias de Paris district, is known for its late-night atmosphere and attracts a diverse crowd of locals and visitors. The event will run into the early hours, providing an extended opportunity to enjoy the music and social environment.

Admission to this event is ticketed. Plano B is situated in central Porto, easily accessible via public transport. It is a short walk from Aliados metro station and various bus stops in the city centre.
